comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Florentine casting recipe "Light cavalry armour manufacturing method". Available from the Chamber of Commerce's Metalcaster during World Clock: 17th Century, Phase 1 only, or with an Adept of Age title equipped. R0 Casting; costs 310 casting consumption and 97,500 ducats to make.

Ingredients:
Steel x20
Suede x20
Pure Iron Sheet x5
8k total fame to equip, no gender restrictions, color-custom.

Stats:
+1 Assault
+1 Swordplay

Images: fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-310.html

comments.author: Daniel
comments.body: Also available in Lubeck item shop with chrono title 16.1 - 16.5
